parsed.title: REST
parsed.body:
Resolve the Infection Procedure.

Remove all non-Infected cards from the game
instead of discarding them.

Infection Procedure:
Scan all Contaminations in hand.
If any of them are Infected, place a Larva
on your Character board. Then, discard all
Contaminations from your hand.
confidentlyVisible: All meaningful typography is upright in the file.

The card has a magenta-purple rules panel and character-label footer.
